Text: In mammals the U snRNAs range in size from {{c1::100::how many}} nucleotides ({{c2::U6::which snRNA}}, the shortest) to {{c1::215::how many}} nucleotides ({{c2::U3::which snRNA}}, the longest).
Back Extra:
Distinguish: some snRNAs of the yeast S. cerevisiae are much larger.

Pitfall: U3, the longest, is the one that is not a spliceosome component (it is nucleolar).
